_comment: USER 2026-11-19, Spirits seed 9 T4 (references/Spirits/claude_s9_gi8, 'I had to manual tap in reference 9'). Board Secluded Courtyard, Unclaimed Territory, Watery Grave, Patrician Geist (graveyard spells cost {1} less), Usher of the Fallen; the drop is Plains. The human casts Lingering Souls {2}{W} as ONE segment and flashes it back ({B} under the Geist) as the NEXT. Both restricted lands make only {C} for a noncreature spell, so the {B} can only come off Watery Grave. Before the fix the payer paid Souls with Plains + Territory + Grave and the flashback dropped (the next menu still offered it, labelled known_drops). Now the human-play demand counts the paid spell's own flashback (MTG_HUMAN_GY_DEMAND): the Courtyard takes the narrow rung, Souls is paid Plains + Territory + Courtyard, and the flashback is paid by the Grave -- four Spirit tokens, nothing dropped.
